name: – Christian Ehler – After § 57 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the assessment of the implementation of Horizon Europe in view of its interim evaluation and recommendations for the 10th Research Framework Programme
part_text: 57a. Stresses the importance of greater reciprocity in association agreements with non-EU countries to ensure equivalent access for European entities, particularly SMEs, to the research programmes of associated non-EU countries; calls for better use of financial adjustment tools in cases of significant imbalances in funding received by entities from associated countries as well as a stricter monitoring and control mechanism to balance openness with the security of European researchers and the protection of investments; stresses, furthermore, the need for a systematic risk-based partner screening to assess the compliance of foreign entities with intellectual property protection, research ethics and reciprocity principles;
